question: Does an effect that says 'Destroy all nonblack creatures' destroy a creature that is both white and black?

expected.shortAnswer: No: a white-and-black creature is black, so it is not destroyed.
expected.answer: An effect that reads “Destroy all black creatures” destroys a white-and-black creature, but one that reads “Destroy all nonblack creatures” doesn’t.
